name: Recruitment Screener
description: Evaluates a candidate resume against a job description, producing a structured scoring assessment with criteria breakdown, strengths, and gaps.

skills.name: Resume-JD Screening
skills.description: Compares a resume against a job description and returns overall score (0-100), verdict, per-criteria breakdown (technical skills, experience, education, domain, scope), strengths, and gaps. Accepts two documents: one with metadata.role='job_description' and one with metadata.role='resume'. Each can be a TextPart (plain text) or FilePart (PDF).
examples: Score this resume against the job description
How well does this candidate match the role?
